description: Add a GENERAL, OPT-IN lean cap options['max_test_cases'] (default None = no cap) that, when set to N, reduces the suite to the N highest-priority test cases AFTER all generation + scope/contamination drops + dedup, reusing the EXISTING humanizer priority/risk machinery (no new ranking). Retain category balance (>=1 TC per major category present) and honor Chalk-first (never drop a Chalk-grounded core TC for a lower-priority analyst/edge TC). Expose the option in the dashboard, default None, so all other features and PI-60 runs are unaffected. Also author the focused tests for both the scope-exclusion feature (FEAT-002/003) and the lean cap, and run the live 4074/4628 verification. Independent of FEAT-003's logic but ordered last so it caps the already-scope-filtered suite; depends on FEAT-002/FEAT-003 being present for the live 4074 end-to-end verification.
steps: In modules/data_first_engine.py add _apply_lean_cap(suite, options, jira, log): n = options.get('max_test_cases'); if not n or len(suite.test_cases) <= n: return (no-op — full suite unchanged). Else, using modules.humanizer: result = dedup_and_merge(list(suite.test_cases), log); score_priority(result, log, feature_priority=getattr(suite,'jira_priority','') or getattr(jira,'priority','')); reorder_by_risk(result, log). Then select the top N while keeping >=1 TC from each major category present among {Happy Path/Positive(core), Negative, Regression} and never evicting a Chalk-grounded core TC (traceability source_type chalk / is_analyst False) in favor of a lower-priority analyst/edge TC. Assign suite.test_cases = selected.
Log '[LEAN] capped suite <before> -> <after> (max_test_cases=N); kept highest-priority balanced set; dropped: <titles>' and append one suite.warnings line summarizing the cap.

Call _apply_lean_cap LAST on BOTH paths: on the main path after _apply_scope_exclusion and after all dedup/polish and BEFORE the final return (after _assert_chalk_coverage/_attach_degraded, i.e. immediately before 'return suite' ~line 833); on the CR path immediately before its return. It must run after scope drops so the cap operates on the filtered set.

Expose the option: in TSG_Dashboard_V8.0.py add 'max_test_cases': None (or a value read from an optional UI control) to the options dict at ~line 1981-1992. Default None so normal runs and all PI-60 features keep full coverage. Do not wire a mandatory UI widget if out of scope — exposing the key with default None is sufficient for a caller/run to set it.

Author tests/test_scope_exclusion.py (covers FEAT-002/FEAT-003): (a) a comment 'scope excluded for cross-environment fan-out' yields an excluded set that drops a 'multi-environment fan-out' scenario but KEEPS an in-scope 'file pickup' scenario (use lightweight TestCase/ExtractedScenario fixtures per tests/conftest.py patterns, or a crafted jira/chalk stub); (b) a feature with no exclusion language drops nothing.

Author tests/test_lean_cap.py: max_test_cases=N returns exactly N highest-priority TCs with category balance (assert at least one Negative retained when present); max_test_cases=None (and key absent) returns the full suite unchanged (count and summaries identical).

LIVE verification (Jira up): delete the 4074 jira_cache row, re-fetch (FEAT-001), then regenerate 4074 WITHOUT cap -> confirm 13 TCs (grounded scope/contamination drops only; TC10/TC11 absent) and WITH max_test_cases=6 -> ~6 TCs covering file pickup, pairing reconcile/auto-correct, already-in-sync no-op, empty-file, malformed rejected, missing/late alert; each grounded, 0 banned, High Level Scenarios sheet reflects the 6. Regenerate 4628 (no cap) -> unchanged (17 with QMetry, keeps legit PRR/Amdocs steps). Record before/after at both levels (16->13 grounded, 13->6 capped) with dropped titles + reason per TC in findings. Delete any temp scripts.
acceptance_criteria: options['max_test_cases']=None or absent -> suite is byte-identical to pre-feature output (tests/test_analyst_mode_regression.py and tests/test_suite_snapshot.py still pass).

options['max_test_cases']=N (N < current count) -> exactly N TCs, ranked by the existing humanizer machinery, with >=1 TC per major category present and no Chalk core TC evicted for a lower-priority analyst/edge TC.
Live: 4074 no-cap = 13 TCs (TC10/TC11 scope-dropped), 4074 max_test_cases=6 = ~6 approved-concept TCs (0 banned, grounded, HLS sheet reflects 6); 4628 no-cap unchanged.
A '[LEAN] capped suite ...' log line and a suite.warnings cap line are emitted only when the cap is applied.
verification: python -m pytest tests/test_scope_exclusion.py tests/test_lean_cap.py tests/test_analyst_mode_regression.py tests/test_suite_snapshot.py -q
Live regeneration of MWTGPROV-4074 (no cap, then max_test_cases=6) and MWTGPROV-4628 (no cap), confirming the counts/contents above; delete temp scripts afterwards.
findings:
IMPLEMENTATION (all committed on feat/scope-exclusion):
- modules/data_first_engine.py: added _apply_lean_cap(suite, options, jira, log) + helpers _lean_category_bucket, _lean_is_chalk_core and constant _LEAN_MAJOR_CATEGORIES (inserted right after _apply_scope_exclusion). It reuses humanizer.dedup_and_merge -> score_priority -> reorder_by_risk (NO new ranking). Selection: (1) always keep user_requested; (2) one highest-priority rep per present major category {Positive/Happy Path, Negative, Regression}; (3) fill remaining slots in risk order with a stable sort that puts Chalk-grounded core TCs (is_analyst False AND traceability.source_type in {Chalk Scenario, Business Rule}) ahead of analyst/edge TCs at the same rank, so a Chalk core TC is never evicted for a lower-priority analyst/edge TC; final reorder_by_risk on the selection. No-op when max_test_cases is None/absent/<=0 or when len(suite.test_cases)<=N. Emits one '[LEAN] capped suite <before> -> <after> (max_test_cases=N); ...; dropped: <titles>' log line + one suite.warnings line ONLY when it actually caps.
- Wired _apply_lean_cap LAST on BOTH paths: main path immediately before 'return suite' (after _assert_chalk_coverage + _attach_degraded); CR path (_build_cr_suite_v8) immediately before its return. Both wrapped in try/except with _record_degraded('lean cap', ...).
- TSG_Dashboard_V8.0.py options dict (~line 1991): added 'max_test_cases': None (default = no cap, so PI-60 and all other runs keep full coverage).
- tests/test_scope_exclusion.py (FEAT-002/003): exclusion comment derives subjects; drops a cross-environment fan-out TC but KEEPS an in-scope file-pickup TC; user_requested never dropped; no exclusion language -> empty set, nothing dropped, no [SCOPE] warning.
- tests/test_lean_cap.py: cap=6 and cap=4 return exactly N with category balance (>=1 Negative; all present majors represented); Chalk core not evicted for lower-priority analyst/edge; None and key-absent and cap>suite are no-ops (suite + warnings unchanged, no [LEAN] warning).

UNIT TESTS: tests/test_scope_exclusion.py + tests/test_lean_cap.py = 10 passed.

BYTE-IDENTICALITY GUARDS (IMPORTANT PRE-EXISTING FAILURE): tests/test_analyst_mode_regression.py + tests/test_suite_snapshot.py = 40 passed, 35 FAILED.
